description.value: Tyee Village Motel is a full-service motel in Port Alberni offering a range of units from standard rooms to full kitchen apartments sleeping up to six, making it a practical base for cyclists tackling the Pacific Rim Highway. The property features an outdoor pool (summer), an independently operated family restaurant open year-round, and free wireless internet. Its central location puts a 7-Eleven one block away and easy highway access within reach.

address.value: 4151 Redford Street, Port Alberni, BC V9Y 3R6

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and provides the primary evidence base. The motel is clearly operational: the rates page lists seasonal room types, and the contact page confirms the address and phone numbers matching OSM's address field. No bike-specific storage or handling is mentioned anywhere on the site; Wi-Fi is explicitly confirmed ('We provide free wireless internet access'); a 7-Eleven one block away is noted on the local services page; and an independently operated family restaurant on-site is described as 'operational year round.'
concerns: OSM tag rooms=1 is almost certainly a data error for a multi-room motel; website lists at least six distinct room/suite types.
OSM has no phone number recorded; website lists two numbers ((250) 723-8133 and toll-free 1-800-663-6676) — phone contact_confirmed set to null as there is nothing in OSM to compare against.

Website title bar uses 'Tyee Motel' while the contact page and OSM both use 'Tyee Village Motel'; the formal legal name appears to be 'Tyee Village Motel' so no change made, but the inconsistency is noted.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operational motel in Port Alberni with a functioning website, confirmed address, and multiple room types suited to touring cyclists on the Pacific Rim corridor.

Nearby evening food.detail: Independently operated family restaurant on-site, described as 'operational year round.'

Nearby grocery.detail: 7-Eleven convenience store one block from the motel, confirmed on local services page
